_comment: Offline Jira-stand-in issue payload (TASK-107 proof fixture; D-A24 mock-per-source-type). Shaped like a Jira REST /issue response: `key` at the top, everything else under `fields`, objects wrapping names/values. A PRIOR ARTIFACT — a previously-delivered epic, the disposition class this source type defaults to.

fields.summary: Discover brand acceptance — authorization parser and routing table
fields.description:
Delivered Discover as an accepted brand at authorization. Scope covered PAN-range recognition for Discover BIN ranges 601100-601109 and 644000-659999, a new brand handler discover_handler, and routing-table entries pointing Discover traffic at the DCI endpoint.

Explicitly OUT of scope for this epic: settlement reconciliation, which was deferred to a follow-on because the recon file format change required a separate network certification. See PBI-4602.
fields.acceptance_criteria: Authorization requests bearing a Discover PAN resolve to card_brand=DISCOVER; discover_handler dispatches to the DCI endpoint; routing table reload does not require a deploy; no regression in Mastercard or Visa dispatch.

comment.body: Certification found that co-badged Discover/Diners cards are not distinguishable by PAN range alone. Raised as a known limitation rather than blocking delivery; the network indicated an explicit brand indicator would follow in a later mandate.
Closing. Settlement reconciliation remains untouched by this epic.
